attchmntText: Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Royal Orchid Hotels Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. The company published newspaper advertisements regarding these results on November 14, 2026, in the Financial Express on page 35 and Vijayavani on page 8. The financial results are available on the company website at www.royalorchidhotels.com. The announcement was signed by Managing Director C.K. Baljee, with DIN 00081844.

attchmntText: Press Release on Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Royal Orchid Hotels Limited filed a press release regarding its financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total income for Q2 FY27 was INR 116.00 crore, compared to INR 86.77 crore in Q2 FY26. Consolidated EBITDA stood at INR 31.66 crore against INR 20.79 crore in the prior year period. Consolidated profit after tax was INR 14.73 crore, with earnings per share at INR 5.25. The company opened five new hotels in Q2, adding 426 room keys. The total portfolio now exceeds 128 hotels across India. The company maintains an asset-light expansion strategy with a pipeline of over 50 upcoming properties.

attchmntText: Board Meeting Outcome for Meeting held on 13th November, 2026.
voiceSummary: Royal Orchid Hotels Limited announced the Board approved un-audited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Standalone profit for the half year was 282.48 lakhs, compared to 387.46 lakhs in the previous year. Revenue from operations stood at 5,222.11 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 1.03. The auditor issued a review report with qualifications regarding ongoing litigation involving associate company Ksheer Sagar Developers Private Limited and a Securities and Exchange Board of India order concerning loss of control. The company filed an appeal against the regulator's order. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 47,788.50 lakhs. Equity stood at 28,598.24 lakhs.

attchmntText: Royal Orchid Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Royal Orchid Hotels Limited has scheduled a conference call for investors and analysts to discuss Q2 and Half Year results for the financial year 2026-27. The event will take place on Monday, November 16, 2026, at 12:00 Noon IST. The management team attending includes Mr. Chander Baljee, Chairman and Managing Director; Mr. Arjun Baljee, President; Mr. Keshav Baljee, Whole Time Director; and Mr. Amit Jaiswal, Chief Financial Officer. Participants are required to register via the provided link to receive joining details. The meeting will be conducted over Zoom with meeting ID 845 1779 8137 and passcode 563451. The call will be recorded in compliance with SEBI regulations.
